ops.body: Source owner /root/long_running_mailbox_index accepted. Confirmed current global-newest roster contract and absence of a writer-owned index in long-running. Investigating existing service seam; Watchman macOS query synchronization is explicitly insufficient per upstream docs. Root asked to choose direct persistent changed-roster index with exact metadata validation or a larger kernel-vnode owner; no TTL/freshness assumption or source changes made yet. Acceptance remains actual targeted warm byte-count and mutation/duplicate/joinedAt parity.
